<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 134.10955, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈133.102 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass within a few ppm and contains only C, H, O and an additional element (N) is C5H13O2N2. This fits the required format CxHyOzX, where X represents the other element(s) (here N2).</thought>
<final_answer>C5H13O2N2</final_answer>
